descriptionHtml:
AMD Ryzen 5 7600X processor:

​Core Specifications

  • ​Total Cores: 6
  • ​Total Threads: 12
  • ​Base Clock: 4.7 GHz
  • ​Max Boost Clock: Up to 5.3 GHz
  • ​Architecture: Zen 4 (Raphael)
  • ​Process Technology: TSMC 5nm FinFET
  • ​Default TDP: 105W
  • ​Unlocked for Overclocking: Yes

​Cache

  • ​L1 Cache: 384 KB
  • ​L2 Cache: 6 MB
  • ​L3 Cache: 32 MB

​Memory Specifications

  • ​System Memory Type: DDR5
  • ​Max Memory Speed: Up to 5200 MT/s
  • ​Memory Channels: 2

​Connectivity & Graphics

  • ​Integrated Graphics: AMD Radeon™ Graphics (2 Cores)
  • ​Graphics Frequency: 2200 MHz
  • ​PCI Express Version: PCIe 5.0
  • ​Socket: AM5

​Thermal Information

  • ​Max Operating Temperature (Tjmax): 95°C
  • ​Thermal Solution: Not included (High-performance cooler recommended)
